items.q: Will you use a recycled theme?
items.a: Never. Every layout is custom in Figma, and all code belongs 100% to you.

items.q: Will you support us after launch?
items.a: Yes. Fixed builds include 30 days of free launch support and care.

items.q: Is ad budget separate from your fee?
items.a: Yes. Media spend goes directly to Meta or Google with zero markup.

items.q: Why do agency website quotes vary?
items.a: Pages, custom motion, CRM integrations, and copy drive hours clearly.
A 7–10 day audit spots leaks first so you never waste dev or ad budget.

items.q: Do you write Hindi and Hinglish campaigns?
items.a: Yes. We craft native English, Hinglish, and Hindi hooks for Indian buyers.
